# Rate‑change patient notice

I run a primary‑care practice with about 150 visits per week and lose ~2 hours per week writing price‑change notices. Draft a short, friendly email to patients announcing a 15% rate increase effective 30 days from now, explaining the reason (benchmark alignment) and reassuring them about continued care. Output only the email body.
